lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the June 30th Town Council meeting, where council takes up first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements — rules that directly shape how buildings go up in this box canyon, and worth showing up for. Council also holds a second work session on the Telluride Energy plan that same night. On the housing side, the Telluride Housing Authority meets June 30th to seat its new Resident Advisory Committee, drawing from fifteen tenant applicants across Town properties.
